desc: The Colt LE6940 is the next evolution in the quality AR-15s from Colt Manufacturing. It employs a monolithic upper with integral free-floating quad rail for accuracy and simplified optic mounting, folding back up iron sights, and the Colt M4 collapsible stock. Additionally this rifle utilizes a 16.1 chrome lined barrel that it delivers on the durability and reliability Colt rifles are known for.
